item.title: Succulent Fine Dining Closes in Houston After Parking and Valet Issues at Regent Square
item.description: Succulent Fine Dining has officially closed its doors, marking the end of a short but memorable chapter in Houston. The California-inspired concept, led by restaurateur Shawn Virene and executive chef David Buckley, earned praise for its seasonal, sustainability-driven menu and polished, approachable dining experience.
